d:
Dhanteras ke pavan avsar se pahle rajdhani patna ke sona-chandi bajar puri tarah saj-dhajkar taiyar ho chuke hain aur logon ne abhi se agrim kharidari shuru kar di hai.
Patna ke pramukh aabhushan vikretaon ke anusar, is sal bajar men pichhle varsh ki tulna men behad shandar karobar rahne ki ummid hai. halanki sone ki kimton men barhotri huee hai, jiske chalte is bar grahkon ki pasand men naya badlav dekhne ko mil raha hai. dukandar batate hain ki log bajat ko dhyan men rakhte hue kam vajan (laitvet) vale lekin dikhne men aakarshak aur 'bharakdar' dijainon ko jyada tarjih de rahe hain.
